description: Only executions whose expiry time falls strictly between the two boundary timestamps are counted.

c.request: Counting order executions that link to an order (`ordersmark` = `recordvault`) belonging to an existing user (`userlink` = `userstamp`), with an expiry time (`expirespot`, compared as text) between '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' and '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533', how many executions are there per account scope (`acctscope`)? Show the account scope and the count. Only executions whose expiry time falls strictly between the two boundary timestamps are counted.
c.sql: SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions AS oe JOIN orders AS o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp WHERE oe.expirespot > '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND oe.expirespot < '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY u.acctscope

d.request: For each account scope, count order executions linked to an order owned by an existing user whose `expirespot`, compared as text, is strictly greater than '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' and strictly less than '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533'; show the account scope and count.
d.sql: SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM users AS u JOIN orders AS o ON o.userlink = u.userstamp JOIN orderexecutions AS oe ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault WHERE oe.expirespot > '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND oe.expirespot < '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY u.acctscope ORDER BY u.acctscope;
